utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still telling folks it’s the repair drive, what to bring, and that it starts this afternoon, and I’m sending anyone interested over too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks, Vik—that helps a lot. I’m handling the tool pickup first, so send anyone interested my way and I’ll keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it, Sam—I’ll keep repeating that it’s the repair drive, what to bring, and that it starts this afternoon, and I’ll send anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Rey—bring the list by when you’ve got it, and we’ll make sure the ladder and drill set are noted right.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, Gus. I’ll bring it by after and make sure your ladder and drill set are clearly marked, and I’ll pass word to Pia that you’ve still got them ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Appreciate it, Rey—once you’ve got that list, we’ll give it a quick look and make sure everything’s squared away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got Noah down for one roll of tape and two pairs of gloves, and I’m leaving trash bags unchecked until he confirms.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fine, Cleo—leave the trash bags unchecked for now and keep Noah down for the tape and gloves. Let me know as soon as he confirms so the list stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do—I’ve got Noah marked for one roll of tape and two pairs of gloves, and I’ll keep the trash bags open until he confirms.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks—if you can peek at the trash bags after drop-off, that’d clear it up, since Cleo’s already got me down for the tape and two pairs of gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll check the trash bags right after drop-off while I look over the sorted tools, then I’ll let you know what we still need before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, thanks—I’d definitely lose track of that, so just let me know before pickup if Cleo should add any trash bags for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we lock anything in, can we check with Quinn on who’s managing the signup list and who last had the clipboard?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, let’s check with Quinn—they were making the rounds, so they probably know who’s got the clipboard by now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, let’s ask Quinn those two details first, and if they know, I’d also like to confirm where the tools are being stored before we finalize anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, it’s the repair drive this afternoon—bring tape, gloves, and any trash bags you’ve got, and check with Ira if you want to confirm the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in late again—I’ll bring tape and gloves, and I’ll check with Ira on the list as soon as I get there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane—that helps a lot. We’re just keeping the word simple: repair drive this afternoon, bring tape, gloves, and any trash bags you can grab.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Jules is checking both sides this afternoon, and I’m still spreading the word while I’m out, so the repair drive should get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, but who’s actually holding the signup list right now, Ira, and how many homes are confirmed as of this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Opal’s holding the signup list right now, and I’m still waiting on Jules to confirm which houses on each side are in this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Opal, I’m on board once we’ve got a clear list—tools, pickup times, and who’s storing and checking things out. If that’s settled, I’ll feel a lot better about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That makes sense—I'm mapping confirmed houses by stretch as Jules and Quinn report back, and once I’ve got the tool list, pickup times, and storage checked in one place, I’ll send it over so you can look it through.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that’s exactly what I need—once I can see it all in one place, I’ll know we’re not going to lose track of tools or leave pickups muddled.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Nell, can you confirm you’ve got Sunday at the community center too, and that Tess is still set once Sam picks up the tools?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’ve heard Sunday at the community center, and last I heard Tess was still set once Sam grabs the tools—but I’m still piecing it together second-hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Nell—that helps, but since it’s second-hand, can you check directly and confirm Tess is still fully set for Sunday at the community center once Sam has the tools?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Bo, from what I’m hearing, the repair drive should line up once Sam grabs the tools, and Gus still has his ladder and drill ready to help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that sounds fine—once Rosa sends me the short list, I’ll skim it and flag any houses that jump out before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Bo—once Rosa sends that list, I’ll keep nudging folks on timing and signups so we’re ready to move when Sam’s got the tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m making the rounds on Maple and Cedar this afternoon, Leo, and I’ll send over the houses that say yes so we can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—send me the list, and I can handle hauling Saturday from 10 to 11 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll keep spreading the word on Maple and Cedar this afternoon and send you the yeses as they come in so hauling’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — that keeps us in good shape. Send your notes this afternoon, and I’ll add those homes to the Sunday community center list right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Rosa — I’m finishing up the tool notes now, and I’ll send over any homes that should be added this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara — once I have them, I’ll fold those homes into the Sunday community center list and keep the repair drive moving smoothly.
